answer: Sybils betray themselves through how they vote, not only what they write. Track each grader's scores across many panels: independent judges disagree in messy ways, scattered like wildflowers in a meadow, while puppets of one operator agree in lockstep, uniform as polished marble. When two identities' votes correlate far beyond chance, merge them into one vote and pay one share. Coordination can't hide behind a whisper; it shows up in the statistics.
